name: telegram
description: Telegram Bot API platform: send, edit and delete messages via Telegram, with inbound long-polling for incoming messages

config_schema.label: Bot Token
config_schema.description: Telegram Bot API token from @BotFather. Never reuse another bot's token — create a fresh bot for omniagent.

config_schema.label: API Base URL
config_schema.description: Base URL of the Telegram Bot API. Override to point at a mock server for tests.

config_schema.label: Enable inbound polling
config_schema.description: Poll Telegram (getUpdates long-polling) for incoming messages

config_schema.label: Poll interval (seconds)
config_schema.description: How often to poll for new messages (getUpdates long-poll timeout)
